items.title: Walter "Furry" Lewis Interview, 1967-05-03
items.q: Oh, I know him, sure. Mm-hmm. He started here on Beale Street... That's where all of us started at, right there.

ctx.x: But you didn't know Bonham or Egfort or Turnoff? No, no. Those fellas, huh?
No, no, I did not. What about Debbie C. Handy?
